title: Pizza That You Can Eat Every Single Day
text: How many people you know like pizza? Do you like pizza? This is a collaboration between Medical Medium Cafe Gratitude. Medical Medium pizzas on the menu. The first of its kind. They've never done a collaboration with somebody with pizzas. They're known for their pizzas around the world. Their pizzas are unbelievable. They're delicious. You should come and try them. But also, when you do, try the Medical Medium pizzas on the menu because those are on another level because of Chef Drew and me. Medical Medium, we work together on the crust. It's a chickpea crust with potato and sweet potato. It is so delicious and so pure and so clean. All of our years of experience went into these crusts. That alone is a whole another level. I love pizzas. I'm all about pizzas. But the problem is you can't get pizzas out there in the world too easy that are really good. There's a lot of oil. There's a lot of salt. I haven't had pizza in so long and sorry I ate both pieces, but it was so good. This is the first time in 9 years where I've gotten to go out to eat with Lauren and she hasn't had to bring her own food. That means the world to see my sister sit down and eat a full meal and be taken care of and not be judged. So to me, the food's excellent, but it's also someone created this environment where you can feel included and seen. It makes me emotional, but it's beautiful. She deserves that all the time.
